linhas.txt: Hello, hello, exploradora! In the Speaking test, the teacher is going to TALK to you. Mas não fica nervosa! O segredo: responde com FRASES COMPLETAS, sorri, e fica calminha. Yay — you can do it!
Answer with COMPLETE sentences ('I have a brother' — not just 'yes')
It's OK to ask: 'Sorry, can you repeat?' or 'Pardon?'
Look at the examiner, smile, take your time
When you DON'T know a word, DESCRIBE it: 'a thing that...'
Pronounce CLEAR even if slow — clarity > speed
